verdict.rationale: Gemini API's own docs say the Interactions API can connect to remote MCP servers: you supply the server name and URL in the tools configuration, giving the model access to those servers' tools. Support is limited to remote servers using Streamable HTTP, with SSE explicitly not supported, and it sits within the Interactions API. Missing for 10: local/stdio MCP server support, SSE transport, evidence of MCP support beyond the Interactions API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Interactions API supports connecting to remote MCP servers to give the model access to external tools and services. You provide the server `name` and `url` in the tools configuration.
